lines.text: Within these halls of crimson and gold
A tale of two companions shall be told
One walks in splendour, sovereign and serene
And should you cease the scratching...
What thunder shakes the palace floor?
What golden beast comes charging through the door?
A heart as vast as England
Cast forth the sacred tennis ball
Let trumpets sound from wall to wall
For Doja and for Bam Bam
I ask for little from this world
A human hand to scratch my ears
There is but one upon this Earth
Together they make one home whole
May golden paws still lead the way
BAM BAM, FETCHING FOR THE KING!
From New Mills unto Albert Hall
THE GREATEST GOLDENS OF THEM ALL!
